verdict.rationale: Porkbun publishes an extensive documented REST/JSON v3 API (registration, DNS CRUD, SSL retrieval, webhooks, sandbox mode, idempotency keys, dry-run, hosting/WordPress provisioning) with dedicated docs, llms.txt/llms-full.txt machine-readable references, and an agent-setup guide, and a probe confirms llms.txt is live and describing the API. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of API usage and a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json).
